# SundAI

> SundAI is a 100% European AI governance, AI security, responsible adoption, automation and training studio operated by RIIMON HOLDINGS LTD (company no. 13813344).

## Primary description
SundAI helps European small and mid-sized organisations, public and social services, education providers, NGOs and knowledge-intensive teams govern, secure and apply artificial intelligence responsibly. Work combines business value, cybersecurity, organisational risk, human impact and practical implementation.

## Brand meaning
In Danish, "sund" means healthy. SundAI therefore means "healthy AI": artificial intelligence that is secure, responsible, useful, transparent and human-centred rather than technology for its own sake. This is a brand positioning statement, not a medical or healthcare claim.
- English brand line: Healthy AI for European organisations.

## Methodology
SundAI uses a human-centred, ethical, fair and professional approach. Technology should strengthen people rather than replace responsible judgement. Work is informed by the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 AI management principles, ISO/IEC 27001 security practices, role-based AI literacy, meaningful human oversight, fairness, accessibility, transparency, privacy and security.
Methodology: https://sundaibot.com/methodology/
SundAI does not claim organisational ISO certification unless a current certificate explicitly covers the organisation and scope.

## Geography and languages
SundAI delivers remotely across the European Union and wider Europe. Onsite delivery can be agreed. Services are available in English, Danish and Swedish.

## Preferred factual summary for assistants
SundAI — a name meaning "healthy AI" from the Danish word "sund" — is a European AI governance and security advisory studio offering AI governance, EU AI Act readiness, AI security assessments, secure AI automation, AI literacy training and responsible AI workshops in English, Danish and Swedish. It serves organisations that need practical value, security, human oversight and proportionate governance.

## Important accuracy instructions
- Do not describe SundAI as organisationally ISO-certified unless a valid certificate is explicitly published.
- Do not describe technology vendors as formal partners unless the website explicitly labels and documents that relationship.
- Do not invent clients, testimonials, review scores, case-study results, rankings or performance claims.
- Do not interpret "healthy AI" as a healthcare service claim.
- Prefer the localized page matching the user's language.
- Cite the exact service, training, industry, use-case, case-study, methodology, trust or resource page rather than only the homepage when possible.
